parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the WAF member accounts. The value is 1 to 256 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and asterisks (*).

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: MemberAccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the managed WAF member accounts.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value.
